summary: The MaintAccountCode system manages account codes within the HSPnet framework, focusing on user interface elements and backend logic for displaying, adding, editing, and deleting account codes.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing account codes in the HSPnet application, allowing users to view, add, edit, or delete account codes based on their permissions.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for each account code.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A description of the account code.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: An integer representing the order in which the account code appears.

fields.name: AgencyID
fields.description: The ID of the agency to which the account code belongs.

actors.permissions: View and edit all account codes.
View and edit account codes for their own agency.
View account codes only, unless additional permissions are granted.

workflows.name: Manage Account Codes
steps: User navigates to the MaintAccountCode page.
System checks user's permissions to determine edit access.
User can view account codes in a grid format.
User can add a new account code by clicking the 'Add' button.
User can edit an existing account code by clicking the 'Edit' button next to the desired entry.
User can delete an account code by clicking the 'Delete' button (if permissions allow).
Changes are saved to the database and the grid is refreshed to reflect updates.

business_rules: Account codes must be unique and associated with an agency.
Only users with appropriate permissions can add, edit, or delete account codes.
validations: Code field is required and has a maximum length of 50 characters.
Description field is required and has a maximum length of 200 characters.
SortOrder field is required and must be an integer.
calculations: SortOrder determines the rendering order within the grid.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable is set to true if the user is a System Administrator or a Local Administrator for the current agency.
system_behavior: Displays error and warning messages in panels.
Uses ASP.NET GridView for data display and manipulation.
Employs Ajax controls for partial-page updates and modals.
dependencies: HSPnet.App_GlobalResources for localization and resource management.
AjaxControlToolkit for modal and control extender functionalities.
exceptions: Errors are captured and displayed within an error panel to guide users.
